issues: 工作台按 30f 截断，渲染在撞停前一帧就结束，负片冲击帧和震屏恢复根本没出现
目标卡打着调试占位大字 "IMPACT"、3px 纯黑粗边，像线框稿
全景 24f 死帧后直接急推，没有预备动作，急推段无任何运动模糊
推到 2.4x 后卡片上下被画框切掉，撞停后画面亮度/焦点毫无变化
changes: 补 ANIME_IMPACT_DURATION = 120：建立 → 预备 → 急推 → 3f 冲击帧 → 震屏 → 约 2.3s 静止读卡
去掉占位字和黑边，目标卡在 6–20f 亮起 1.5px 靛蓝描边 + 6px 柔光晕并略微抬高，先告诉观众拳头落在哪
全景 1→1.012 极缓 creep，22–28f 回拉到 0.985 做预备；急推段（28–33f）按位移自适应 2–12 个子帧做时间采样运动模糊，并叠一层跟随卡心的径向锐利遮罩，模仿变焦模糊
冲击帧负片加 contrast(1.45) 压成墨黑；集中线改成 34 根粗楔 + 22 根细针，内端用径向渐隐柔化，每帧换形态
推近倍率改为 2.25x，卡片完整入画；撞停后暗角 0.42→0.16、卡外压暗 22%→10%，22f 内回落；震屏用 cos 起相并加 ≤0.24° 微旋转
issuesEn: The workbench cut it at 30f, so the render ended one frame before the hit: the negative impact frames and shake recovery never appeared
The target card carried a debug placeholder "IMPACT" headline and a 3px solid black border, like a wireframe
A dead 24-frame wide hold went straight into the push, with no wind-up and no motion blur
At 2.4x the card was cropped top and bottom, and nothing changed in brightness or focus after the hit
changesEn: Added ANIME_IMPACT_DURATION = 120: setup, wind-up, crash, 3f impact frames, shake, then about 2.3s of still reading time
Removed the placeholder text and black border; at 6–20f the target card picks up a 1.5px indigo outline and a 6px soft halo and lifts slightly, so the audience knows where the punch will land

Slow 1→1.012 creep on the wide shot and a 22–28f pull-back to 0.985 as wind-up; the 28–33f push gets temporal-sampling motion blur (2–12 adaptive sub-frames) plus a sharp radial mask that tracks the card centre to mimic zoom blur
The negative frames add contrast(1.45) for ink-black; speed lines are now 34 thick wedges plus 22 thin needles with radially feathered inner ends, re-drawn every frame

Push target lowered to 2.25x so the card stays fully in frame; after the hit the vignette goes 0.42→0.16 and the surroundings dim 22%→10% over 22f; the shake is cosine-phased with ≤0.24° micro-rotation
